verdict.summary: The S2-pinned falsifier reads BELOW the S4 floor in every case (worst certified upper bound 3.080e-13 vs floor 1e-9) while the non-vacuity gate clears and the detector is loaded at O(1e-1). The literal S4 combination is therefore met. Its stated MECHANISM is refuted: the tau-EVEN (class-leaving) channel is NOT annihilated - an identically class-leaving direction on the detector's own index support reads 5.188e-08 to 4.796e-05, inside the S3(a) window. The pinned A_0 reads zero by exact trace-orthogonality: an exact parity selection rule confines the detector to the |i-j| = 4 stride, and A_0 lives entirely on the |i-j| = 1 stride.
